item.title: AlumKnight Jay Pineda earns Dean’s List honors in Portland
item.description: (Press Release) — Jay Francis O. Pineda, a proud AlumKnight of Mount Carmel School in the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, has earned a prestigious place on the Dean’s List at the University of Portland for his outstanding academic performance. The post AlumKnight Jay Pineda earns Dean’s List honors in Portland appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Schoolbell.net announces 3 best private schools in NMI
item.description: SINGAPORE (Press Release) — Schoolbell.net, a global education discovery platform, today announced the publication of its list of the three best private schools in the Northern Mariana Islands for 2025, ranking top institutions across the Commonwealth based on contextual reputation scores that reflect online credibility, visibility, and trustworthiness. The post Schoolbell.net announces 3 best private schools in NMI appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Saipan Humane Society adjusts communication policy to protect staff and sustain services
item.description: (SHS) — Saipan Humane Society has announced a new policy limiting client communication to official SHS channels only. This change comes as part of the organization’s commitment to sustainability, staff well-being, and long-term community service. The post Saipan Humane Society adjusts communication policy to protect staff and sustain services appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Smiling Cove Marina renamed for Diego Benavente
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang on Monday approved House Local Bill 24-29, renaming Smiling Cove Marina in honor of the late former Lt. Gov. Diego Tenorio Benavente. The post Smiling Cove Marina renamed for Diego Benavente appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Mitsui Ocean Fuji docks in Saipan
item.description: THE Mitsui Ocean Fuji, a Japanese luxury cruise ship from Tokyo, arrived in Saipan Tuesday morning with 419 passengers and 346 crew before departing later for Guam. The post Mitsui Ocean Fuji docks in Saipan appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Beach Road renamed for late Gov. Palacios
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang on Monday signed Senate Local Bill 24-2 into law, renaming Beach Road in honor of his predecessor, the late Gov. Arnold I. Palacios. The post Beach Road renamed for late Gov. Palacios appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: PSS honors two educators after decades of service
item.description: (PSS) — The Public School System is paying tribute to two tireless educators whose careers span some of the most important chapters in PSS history. The post PSS honors two educators after decades of service appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: DPS promises transparent investigation into alleged assault by officers
item.description: DEPARTMENT of Public Safety Commissioner Anthony I. Macaranas on Tuesday said DPS is ensuring “a transparent and unbiased investigation” into allegations that two police officers assaulted a man with a mental disability in Marpi on Dec. 19. The post DPS promises transparent investigation into alleged assault by officers appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Luxury shop shutting down amid drop in tourism
item.description: GEMKELL Saipan, one of the island’s remaining luxury retail shops, will close its doors on Dec. 31, citing a continued decline in tourist arrivals and weakening demand for high‑end goods. The post Luxury shop shutting down amid drop in tourism appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: One Stop Business Permitting Center opens on Capital Hill
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang and other CNMI officials on Monday held a ribbon-cutting ceremony to open the One Stop Business Permitting Center on Capital Hill. The post One Stop Business Permitting Center opens on Capital Hill appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.
